selection.exactTextDuplicateRule: For the selected Portuguese morphology field, any exact full-text value present for more than one COL ID is quarantined for manual source review; raw source rows remain unchanged.

semanticAudit.method: Deterministic stratified sample of 100 of 17,769 exact morphology+habitat COL IDs; language strata en=34, pt=33, es=33; sampled morphology rows were source-cited and row-located; habitat rows were dataset-scoped, with unknowns and multiple values retained as such.
semanticAudit.exclusion: No duplicate-text morphology row is asserted per species in this batch; exact-text duplicate groups are separately hashed and listed below. Explicit unknown habitat values are not claims.

source.sourceVersion: WFO Brazilian Flora 2020 archive; embedded EML v393.147
